title: Parfum Blender/GLB
description: 3D perfume bottle modelled in Blender and exported to GLB: the model is rendered in real time in a WebGL canvas. The rotation around the vertical axis and the dissolve/re-form cycle are applied on the WebGL side, reusing the behaviors from the Parfum WebGL version. Hovering over the bottle freezes the effects and the mouse wheel zooms.
